description:
The Java Developer will be tasked with developing, creating and modifying general computer applications software or specialized utility programs. Analyzing user needs and developing software solutions. Designing software or customizing software for client use with the aim of optimizing operational efficiency. May analyze and design databases within an application area, working individually or coordinating database development as part of a team.
 Requirements: 
 
 
 • Agile/Scrum experience 
 • BS/BA in Computer Science / Engineering or related technical degree
 • Minimum of 2 years of experience with Spring MVC 4.0 or higher
 • Minimum of 3 years of experience with Java and OO concepts
 • Experience in configuring/working with Spring MVC using annotations
 • Experience configuring and using Spring Boot
 • Experience with persistence providers like Hibernate or JPA
 • Experience with developing & consuming REST APIs
 • Experience with developing test cases & testing using JUnit, Mockito, dbUnit, etc.
 • 1-2 years of experience working with relational databases via Spring
 • Experience working with JSON
 • Experience with development tools: Jetbrains IntelliJ, Maven, Git
 • Able to take specification and turn it into working code with little oversight
 • At least intermediate level understanding of http and database caching techniques
 • Ability to set priorities, adapt to change, and meet established timelines
 Optional but desired: 
 
 • Knowledge and/or experience using Spring Security
 • Experience deploying Spring Applications to an application server
 • Hands on experience using the Atlassian tool stack (JIRA, Confluence, Bitbucket Server, Bamboo)
 • Hands on experience on Microsoft SQL Server / Transact-SQL
 • Knowledge on integrating REST services with Angular JS/JavaScript based application
